message:
Nicknames now work: `createUser` accepts `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when unset. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the two in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

The change touches three files:

- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js`** (new): adds a `nickname` column to `users`. The `Db` layer rejects writes to unknown columns, so the column is required. I added a new migration rather than editing 001 or 002, since those are already applied in production. The migrations README says the DBA team owns this directory, so please have them review this file before it ships.
- **`src/api/users.js`**: `createUser` takes `nickname` and stores it, defaulting to `null`. `getUser` returns `nickname` as `r.nickname ?? null`.
- I didn't touch `test/users.test.js`. Its `deepStrictEqual` still passes because `createUser` returns the same shape `getUser` produces.
